drawings.description: en bas à gauche, un croquis : un anneau hachuré $\widetilde{\partial P}$ bordé par le cercle $\partial P$
drawings.kind: hatched annulus bordered by a circle
drawings.notes: An annulus between two circles, hatched by short radial strokes (their number schematised), labelled with the tilde-boundary of P inside at the top; the outer circle is labelled del P at the right.

drawings.description: à gauche et à droite, deux croquis de flèches entre $\partial P$, $\widetilde{\partial P}$, $\partial P'$, $\widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P$, $\widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P'$ et $P - P' = \widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P'$, avec la mention « équivalences d'\ill{} »
drawings.kind: two arrow sketches between boundaries of P and P'
drawings.notes: Left: del P' and del P above and below, joined by arrows to tilde-del P - del P and tilde-del P - del P' (each followed by an equivalence sign) and to tilde-del P, with "= P - P'" beside; right: del P -> tilde-del P <- del P', with tilde-del P - del P below and P - P' = tilde-del P - del P' above, and "équivalences d'..." under it (the last word illegible, as in the transcription). Arrow directions as on the page; the left sketch is crossed by the large frame line of the page, not drawn.

drawings.description: croquis dans la marge gauche ; sous $P \cap Q = R$, en colonne : $\partial P = T$, le $R$ étant surchargé
drawings.kind: margin diagram of inclusions W, P, Q, P cap Q = R = del P
drawings.notes: Q° over Q, W -> Q (hooked), P inside W (vertical inclusion), P° -> P and P <- P cap Q = R (hooks), and under P cap Q = R, in a column, del P = T; the R is overwritten. The hooks are drawn as small curls at the line ends.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : un disque marqué « $P$ », entouré d'un anneau hachuré ; à droite de l'anneau, « $\widetilde{P}$ ».
drawings.notes: Two nested closed curves drawn freehand, the ring between them hatched with short oblique strokes; P inside the inner curve, P-tilde to the right of the outer one. Outside the ring on the right, a curved stroke runs from the top down and round the lower right of the outer curve: drawn as on the page (it looks like a second pass of the outer contour). The curves are drawn as ellipses fitted to the page; the hatching strokes are placed by eye. The transcription's note matches. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la page, premier diagramme en perspective : les lettres $S$, $W$, $T$ en haut, $P$, $Q$, $M$, $R$, $N$, $t$ au milieu, $T$ et $S$ repassés, $(s,t)$, $\emptyset$ et $t$ en bas, reliées par des flèches montantes dont plusieurs épaisses ; des ovales au crayon entourent des groupes de lettres ; deux plages hachurées, à gauche et à droite en bas.
drawings.kind: arrow diagram in perspective (lattice of inclusions), with hatched regions
drawings.notes: The letters are placed as on the page and the arrows drawn between the places where they start and end on the page: M to the upper left, P to S (top), a faint line from s to S, P to W and M to P (hooked), R to P (heavy), Q to the upper left (heavy), Q to T, t to T, R to Q, N to Q, N to t, T (heavy letter) to M, T to R, S (heavy letter) to R, S to N, (s,t) to T and to S, the empty set to (s,t), S down to the lower t (heavy), and a dashed stroke from that t up to a small T on the right. Under R, a small vertical equality sign and T x S. Four pencil ovals surround P and R, M and T, R and Q, S and N; two scribbled hatchings at the lower left (with two small s) and lower right. Partial: the hooks, dots and small crosses on several arrows (M to P, P to W, T to R, S to N carry a hook or a cross) are not drawn; arrow heads retraced on the page are drawn once; the ovals and hatchings are placed by eye; which letter each arrow reaches is read from its direction, and several are doubtful (Q's upper-left arrow ends in the blank between W and T; M's ends near the small s). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous, second diagramme en perspective, sur les lettres correspondantes : $V'$ et $V'_s$ en haut, $X'_{\eta}$, $V'_s$, $t$, $e$ au milieu, $X'_{\eta}$, $V'_s \times \eta$, $V'_s$, $\eta$, $(s,t)$, $t$ en bas, reliées par des flèches montantes épaisses ; un cadre en traits doubles et un cadre au crayon ; à droite, un quadrilatère hachuré.
drawings.kind: arrow diagram in perspective (lattice of inclusions), with frames and a hatched region
drawings.notes: The letters are placed as on the page and the arrows drawn between the places where they start and end. A frame of heavy and double strokes runs round X'_eta and V'_s x eta; a thin pencil quadrilateral lies under the lower X'_eta and V'_s; at the right a small quadrilateral is hatched, with an arrow from its upper right corner. Left out: the node at the top left, blotted out in ink (two arrows end on it; they are drawn); the letter at the far right, struck (it reads V'_s or X'_s) and the small round letter beside the hatched quadrilateral (e or a zero); the small s at the left is drawn although it looks struck. Partial: hooks and tildes on several arrows are not drawn (the arrows V'_s to V'_s at the top right and e to t carry a tilde; the second is drawn as a plain stroke); which letter each arrow joins is read from its direction; frames and hatching are placed by eye. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
